attribute_information.country: Country of origin of the eDNA parent sample
attribute_information.filter_size: Pore size of the filter used to capture environmental DNA (for water samples)
attribute_information.filter_type: Material or model of filter used to capture environmental DNA (for water samples)
attribute_information.fwd_probe_name: Forward probe or primer name (such as LCO1490, MiFish-UF)
attribute_information.fwd_probe_seq: Nucleotide sequence of the forward primer or probe used to amplify or detect the target DNA region
attribute_information.genotyping_technology: Either amplicon, genomic DNA or RNA in an eDNA or microbiome study framework
attribute_information.id: ID referring to the sample in the ASV/OTU read count file. Warning : one unique id per amplicon (i.e. primer /probe) in case of amplicon sequencing
attribute_information.is_blank: Indicates if a sample is a negative control
attribute_information.library: Name of the targeted DNA region amplified for sequencing, such as 16S or 18S, for instance
attribute_information.number_of_cycles: Total number of sequencing cycles performed during a sequencing run
attribute_information.organism: Either eDNA_spp or microbiome_spp in an eDNA / microbiome study framework
attribute_information.ref_database: Curated database of DNA sequences (name and version) used to assign taxonomic identities to sequencing reads (i.e. Greengenes 138, SILVA 123)
attribute_information.rev_probe_name: Reverse probe or primer name (such as LCO1490, MiFish-UF)
attribute_information.rev_probe_seq: Nucleotide sequence of the reverse primer or probe used to amplify or detect the target DNA region
attribute_information.sample_field_blank: ID referring to the parent eDNA sample (one unique id for each sampling date / time) that was sequenced using one or several primers
attribute_information.sample_type: Type of environmental material collected for DNA analysis, such as soil, water, etc...
attribute_information.sampled_quantity: Amount of environmental material collected for DNA analysis
attribute_information.sampling_date: Date on which the environmental parent sample was collected, expressed in the standard ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DD
attribute_information.sampling_depth: Depth at which the environmental aprent sample was collected
attribute_information.sampling_time: Time (or time range) at which the environmental parent sample was collected, expressed in ISO 8601 format (hh:mm:ss; for a range: 13:00–15:00)
attribute_information.sequenced_molecule: Sequenced molecule such as DNA, RNA...
attribute_information.sequencing_instrument: Name of the targeted DNA region amplified for sequencing, such as 16S or 18S, for instance
attribute_information.sequencing_mode: Read configuration used during sequencing, such as single-end, paired-end, long read sequencing
attribute_information.tide: Tidal phase during which the environmental parent sample was collected

meta.description: Code Béluga is a community science initiative led by Génome Québec and Espace pour la vie. The project uses environmental DNA (eDNA) collected from water samples to deepen our understanding of biodiversity in the St. Lawrence River Estuary. Citizens collect water samples following a standardized protocol, and these samples are analyzed at Génome Québec’s expertise center to identify the species present in the ecosystem. The dataset currently contains 915 samples collected at four sites over three distinct sampling dates per year - spring, summer, and fall. Each sample was sequenced for the 12S, 16S, 18S, MiDeca, and COI amplicons in order to obtain the most realistic representation possible of the diversity of species present.
meta.name: Code Béluga
